svg.title: Sands of Time — Dominion of Hours. Fable proposal — 2026-10-04 batch rebalance / Sand classification / forked tree.
svg.desc: 10 skills, 4 purchases, one Advanced Art maximum. Borrowed Hours forks into Quickened Sands then Sovereign of the Hour, or Brittle with Age then The Inevitable Hour. Suspended Moment forks into Held in Stasis then Timeless Bastion, or Leaden Seconds then Stilled Hourglass. No paths converge. Bonuses apply to matching supported tags on all Sand jutsu.

Timeshift adds a second, broad 35% exposure row and Cellular Regeneration a static Heal 25 (250 HP per tick). The tree follows those pairs: an offensive Foundation on Momentum Shift (amplify myself or expose them) and a defensive Foundation on Timelapse (shelter myself or weaken them). Damage gets no node: Eternity Flux is a 50 Nuke, so any flat Damage pushes it past the tier ladder. Routes: Self-amplification +10% Increase Damage Given, Exposure +8% Increase Damage Taken, Fortress +10% Decrease Damage Taken with +5% Heal, Suppression +10% Decrease Damage Given. Stun, timecompression and barrier are unsupported and receive nothing."},"nodes":[{"id":"01","name":"Borrowed Hours","category":"Foundation","cost":1,"parents":[],"modifiers":[{"tag":"increasedamagetaken","flat":2,"display_role":"ENEMY DEBUFF"},{"tag":"increasedamagegiven","flat":2,"display_role":"SELF BUFF"}],"flavor":"Every second stolen from them is a second lent to you.","coverage_note":"Increase Damage Taken 35 \u2192 37% on Timeshift (four stat types, no element) and Momentum Shift (Earth/None/Sand/Wind hits); Hourglass"]}],"narrow_kit_exception":null,"design_notes":["Structure unchanged (01\u219202\u219203, 01\u219204\u219205, 06\u219207\u219208, 06\u219209\u219210); the Foundations follow the kit's paired jutsu. Changes from Draft 4: the +5 Damage route is gone (Grinding Sands / Erosion of Eternity become Quickened Sands / Sovereign of the Hour, Increase Damage Given 2/3/5); The Inevitable Hour drops its Increase Damage Given rider and is pure exposure (2/2/4 = +8%); Suspended Moment trades Heal +2% for Decrease Damage Given +2%; Timeless Bastion carries the whole +5% Heal; Stilled Hourglass is +5% Decrease Damage Given (route still +10%) with +2% Decrease Damage Taken.","No flat Damage: the Sand rows are 40/40/50, so any flat Damage lifts Eternity Flux above the 50 Nuke tier, and the old +5 also took Timeshift and Timelapse 40 \u2192 45. The kit's hits are already multiplied by its own Increase Damage Given / Increase Damage Taken rows and the Earth/None/Sand/Wind Increase Damage Given passive.","Exposure is held at +8%, below self-amplification's +10%, because it is the higher-leverage tag: two rows that compound on one hit and amplify allies' hits too. With all three Momentum Shift / Timeshift rows live, a kit Sand hit takes \u00d72.72 (Sovereign route) or \u00d72.80 (Exposure route) at 3 BP and \u00d72.80 / \u00d72.86 with the offensive fourth, Brittle with Age / Quickened Sands (base \u00d72.46). With Momentum Shift alone the order flips (\u00d71.99 vs \u00d71.96), and only self-amplification reaches other targets.","Defence: both routes use one Timelapse cast. An enemy in the circle hits the caster at \u00d70.408 (Fortress) or \u00d70.396 (Suppression) at 3 BP, \u00d70.39 or \u00d70.378 with the sibling Hidden Art (base \u00d70.49); the Fortress keeps its Heal, the Suppression covers every enemy in the circle and the caster's allies. Maxima over every legal allocation: Increase Damage Given +10%, Increase Damage Taken +8%, Decrease Damage Taken +10%, Decrease Damage Given +10%, Heal +5%, Damage none.","Matching and delivery (tags.ts 3477\u20133510; \u00a73b): Timeshift's exposure and Timelapse's rows list four stat types and no element, so they match nearly every non-pierce hit; Momentum Shift's exposure matches only Earth/None/Sand/Wind hits; its self buff ('Highest', no element) matches the caster's highest-stat and element-less hits. Every cast has cooldown 7 and buff/debuff rows act the two rounds after the cast round only."],"risks":["Classification: Sand is the single signature element and no other captured kit carries it. 4 of 9 kit rows carry Sand; the other five need the proposed jutsu-classification resolver, and Cellular Regeneration carries no element on any row, so in-kit it qualifies only through an authored Sand jutsu classification (ENGINE_GAP_REGISTER G1). Off-kit Sand coverage is unverified.","Exposure reach: The Inevitable Hour's 43% rows amplify allies' hits as well as the caster's, and any other Increase Damage Taken source multiplies again (stacking on, process.ts 1109-1117). Team value is larger than the duel arithmetic above.","Area suppression reach: Stilled Hourglass's 40% Decrease Damage Given lands on every enemy in the Timelapse circle and cuts their damage to the caster's allies too; worth more in team battles than one row suggests.","Heal: static heal is \u00d710 HP per tick, so +5% Heal adds 50 HP per tick (600 per cast vs 500). The SELF row on the EMPTY_GROUND spiral lands on the caster at cast time, not through the tiles (actions.ts 980-1004), and ticks on the two following rounds only. Healprevent blocks it.","Highest-stat resolution (G16): Momentum Shift's self buff lists 'Highest', resolved from the caster's highestOffence (a required BattleUserState field, types.ts 156). If undefined, it would still match element-less hits and the kit's own Sand rows, not other elemental jutsu.","No combat simulation: stun, timecompression, the barrier, circle target counts, AP and uptime were not modelled. A sealed or prevented Timelapse cast removes both defensive routes' value for that cycle. g.text: Foundations support. Hidden Arts focus. Advanced Arts define.
1 BP each · Acquire points with silver
Bonuses apply to matching supported tags on all Sand jutsu. Combat scopes stay unchanged.
Finish a path in 3 purchases. Spend your fourth on support or a sibling Hidden Art.
Any two Advanced Arts require at least 5 points. Your limit is 4.
Each skill purchased once · Only your current bloodline unlocks · No converging paths
Examples are choices, not locked presets. Advanced Arts are optional.
Sovereign of the Hour path + Brittle with Age
The Inevitable Hour path + Suspended Moment
IDG: Increase Damage Given · DDG: Decrease Damage Given · IDT: Increase Damage Taken · DDT: Decrease Damage Taken · HEAL: Heal
FINAL TAG VALUES ON THE SANDS OF TIME KIT
Jutsu level 25 · main-tree bonuses and bloodline passives excluded
Static bonuses: a 35% tag with +5% becomes 40%. A 40 EP jutsu with +5 Damage becomes 45EP.
On a static Heal effect each +1% Heal adds 1 heal power, which heals 10 HP per tick (display conflict under review).
Proposed behavior: needs a jutsu-classification potency resolver. The current resolver matches each effect's own elements.
14 legal four-skill allocations · 4 Advanced Arts available · Combat tuning remains experimental
Fable proposal — 2026-10-04 batch rebalance / Sand classification / forked tree
